phase: P11 - Final SIH Readiness & Claims Audit

claims.evidence: 131 official districts across 8 Northeastern States (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Sikkim, Tripura).
claims.safe_presentation_wording: NexSolve covers the 8 Northeastern States of India within a 131-district official administrative framework.
claims.unsafe_wording: NexSolve provides real-time sensor coverage for all villages across India.

claims.evidence: Survey of India (ABDB LGD Integrated) official GeoJSON boundaries (ner_states_soi.geojson and ner_districts_soi.geojson).
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Official Survey of India boundaries form the core administrative spatial framework.
claims.unsafe_wording: Boundaries are downloaded from OpenStreetMap or arbitrary GitHub repos.

claims.evidence: Acquired from USGS / AWS Open Data Elevation Archive (NASADEM 1 Arc-Second 30m SRTM DEM); processed in district_terrain_summary.json.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Terrain elevation data was acquired through the USGS/AWS Open Data Elevation Archive and processed to derive elevation, slope, aspect, and curvature features.

claims.evidence: 10,492 historical Geological Survey of India (GSI) landslide inventory records integrated.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Historical baseline incorporates 10,492 GSI landslide inventory records.

claims.evidence: Promoted Candidate A Random Forest (candidate_a_rf_v1 v1.1.0, SHA: 1acad34e85b53df0cb68e5e81cd81d68066c4173792e65a51288b35557ba0f72).
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Powered by a promoted Random Forest classifier evaluated on temporal holdout dataset.
claims.unsafe_wording: Deep Neural Network / LLM predicting exact landslide timing.

claims.evidence: Exactly 7 features (latitude, longitude, rainfall_1d, rainfall_3d, rainfall_7d, month_sin, month_cos). Zero leakage.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Model operates on a strict 7-feature contract comprising spatial coordinates, multi-day rainfall accumulation, and seasonality.

claims.evidence: Temporal holdout evaluation: ROC-AUC 0.9206, PR-AUC 0.9328, F1 0.8258, Brier 0.119, ECE 0.059-0.062. Earlier 0.9902 leak was identified and eliminated.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Evaluated on temporally separated holdout data achieving ~0.9206 ROC-AUC and ~0.9328 PR-AUC. Earlier 0.99+ estimates were identified as temporally contaminated and discarded.
Prototype decision thresholds establish internal decision-support levels.

claims.evidence: 16 districts have scored vulnerability profiles (8 COMPUTED, 8 PARTIAL); 115 districts remain INSUFFICIENT_DATA with score null.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Scored vulnerability profiles are currently available for 16 districts with open dataset indicators; missing data is transparently flagged as INSUFFICIENT DATA.
claims.unsafe_wording: Complete exposure metrics for all 131 districts.

claims.evidence: Open-Meteo precipitation feed API with fallback handling. Stale weather downgrades confidence.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Real-time rainfall feed powered by regional weather station APIs with data quality tracking.

claims.evidence: Containerized deployment configuration prepared (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, GET /api/ready). Public cloud deployment: NOT_VERIFIED.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: Containerized deployment configuration is prepared and tested via production-like readiness probes.
claims.unsafe_wording: Deployed live on AWS/Azure for government operations.

claims.evidence: is_official_warning = false hardcoded. 4-point human verification checklist rendered in UI.
claims.safe_presentation_wording: NexSolve is an internal decision-support tool. Official public warning authority remains strictly with authorized government authorities (SDMA/NDMA).
